properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for enable Conditional access for users with RIsk based authentication
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that:MFA is enforced for all non-privileged user accounts for access to resources, regardless of device, device trust level, or network location.Single sign-on (SSO) is used for subsequent access to resources and applications when a user is authenticated with MFA.For high-risk resources and applications, or when authentication lifetime is exceeded, users may be required to re-authenticate with MFA.
